name: Lean.Meta.EtaStructMode.casesOn
typeText:
{motive : Lean.Meta.EtaStructMode → Sort u} →
  (t : Lean.Meta.EtaStructMode) →
    motive Lean.Meta.EtaStructMode.all →
      motive Lean.Meta.EtaStructMode.notClasses → motive Lean.Meta.EtaStructMode.none → motive t

source.code:
/-- Which structure types should eta be used with? -/
inductive EtaStructMode where
  /-- Enable eta for structure and classes. -/
  | all
  /-- Enable eta only for structures that are not classes. -/
  | notClasses
  /-- Disable eta for structures and classes. -/
  | none
  deriving Inhabited, BEq
